Definition: Status emitted when solve-required physical inputs are missing; blocks mechanics solving for the affected subject.
Status meaning displacements, reactions, forces, moments, stresses, or related open-mechanics quantities were computed for a specific model snapshot.
Status meaning the rule-pack evaluator lacks required user-supplied code data, owner data, provenance, or private project inputs; may coexist with MECHANICS_SOLVED.
Status meaning a user-defined rule pack ran against the available result; a software computation, not a professional code-compliance statement.
Status meaning a user-defined rule pack returned at least one failing check.
Status indicating professional use always requires competent human review; expected on reportable result envelopes.
External human acceptance record value bound to exact model, result, rule-pack, and report hashes; never emitted as an automatic status.
A positive rule status token not currently defined or emitted by OpenPipeStress; positive outcomes use USER_RULE_CHECKED plus rule_check_details.
Details accompanying USER_RULE_CHECKED, such as rule-pack references, evaluation evidence, and a no-failures-reported detail.
Field representing automatic software status, from which human acceptance is represented separately.
Container carrying analysis subject reference, software statuses, status stage and basis, metadata, hashes, and professional-boundary fields.
Separate, external, hash-bound record of human acceptance referencing HUMAN_APPROVED_FOR_PROJECT.
Fields fixed false for software compliance, certification, sealing, approval, and authentication claims.
The software system whose result envelopes carry analysis statuses.
User-defined set of rule definitions evaluated against a result; identified by identity, version, and checksum.
